title: 1 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 15
description: Ten questions on 1 Samuel 15: Saul spares Agag and the best of the animals, and Yahweh rejects him from being king.

questions.text: Which people did Yahweh command Saul to strike and utterly destroy?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Now go and strike Amalek, and utterly destroy all that they have."

questions.text: Where did Saul count the people before the attack?
questions.explanation: Saul summoned the people and counted them in Telaim.

questions.text: Whom did Saul warn to depart from among the Amalekites?
questions.explanation: Saul told the Kenites to depart, for they showed kindness to Israel when they came up out of Egypt.
He took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive.

answers.text: Agag the king of the Amalekites
The captain of the army of Moab

questions.text: What did Samuel do after Yahweh said it grieved him that he had made Saul king?
questions.explanation: Samuel was angry, and he cried to Yahweh all night.

answers.text: He cried to Yahweh all night
He went to Saul at once

questions.text: Where did Saul set up a monument for himself?
questions.explanation: Samuel was told that Saul came to Carmel and set up a monument for himself.

questions.text: What did Samuel hear that showed the animals had not been destroyed?
questions.explanation: Samuel asked what the bleating of the sheep and the lowing of the cattle meant.

answers.text: The neighing of horses and chariots
The bleating of sheep and the lowing of cattle
The roaring of lions in the hills
The crowing of roosters at dawn

questions.text: According to Samuel, what is better than sacrifice?
questions.explanation: Samuel said, "Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to listen than the fat of rams."

questions.text: What did Saul grab as Samuel turned around to go away, so that it tore?
questions.explanation: As Samuel turned around to go away, Saul grabbed the skirt of his robe, and it tore.

questions.text: To whom did Samuel say Yahweh had given the kingdom?
questions.explanation: Samuel said Yahweh had given it to a neighbor of Saul's who is better than he.
